files.title: Image URLs
files.description: Direct links to photos, screenshots or scans (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, TIFF, SVG).

formats.title: Only these formats
formats.description: Leave empty to read every supported format. Restricting is faster and avoids false hits.

includePositions.title: Include corner positions
includePositions.description: Adds each code's four corners (pixels in the original image).

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger files are skipped with an error (not charged).
